info_title: Get in touch and request an estimate
info_text: Fastest response is in messengers. For accurate estimate, attach opening photos or plan right away.
form_text: Describe your task and attach photos. We will provide timeline and budget estimate.
form_add_photo_hint: You can add up to 8 photos (JPG/PNG/WebP, up to 10 MB each).
form_policy_prefix: By clicking the button, you agree with the
form_phone_title: Enter phone number without country code
form_msg_photo_invalid_type: File "{{NAME}}" was skipped: only image files are allowed.
form_msg_photo_too_large: File "{{NAME}}" was skipped: size is over 10 MB.
form_msg_photo_max_count: You can upload no more than {{MAX}} photos.
form_msg_submit_success: Request sent. Thank you! We will contact you shortly.
form_msg_submit_error: Automatic sending failed. Telegram will open now so you can submit manually.
success_modal_next_text: We will review your input, assess a realistic budget and timeline scenario, and come back with a specific comment on your project.
success_modal_speed_title: How to speed up the reply
success_modal_speed_text: If you have more photos, videos, or an opening plan, send them in messenger. This helps us give a more accurate reply faster.
error_modal_help_text: The request could not be sent automatically. We prepared a manual Telegram fallback so your entered data is not lost.
error_modal_timer_text: In a few seconds Telegram will open with a prefilled request text. You can cancel the redirect and stay on the site if needed.
